name: stream-inbox-classifier
label: Classify conversations
description: One agent reads each given Stream Inbox conversation and proposes its tag; the main agent defines a tag for each conversation no tag fits and checks it with the decision model. Answers one proposal — conversation x tag plus the tag tree changes. Writes nothing.

exe_data.prompt: Classify the conversations your input names (ids in `conversations`, or the window `since` / `until`) with the stream-inbox-classifier skill. Submit the checked value as the skill says and answer with the reference it gives you and the number of conversations.
